risks: model ranking does not hold across windows
only 3 validation windows: weight estimation is high variance
diagnosis.narrative: The series is dominated by a strong upward trend (a net rise of ~56% of its level). A moderate seasonal pattern is present. Predictability is middling — structured signal and irregular noise are balanced. The series reads as non-stationary by the ADF/KPSS tests. Across validation windows the model ranking is unstable (Kendall tau 0.119), which favours a robust combination.

Test a single best model from the full pool (ETS) to see if a pure model beats robust combos.
Test a weighted combination using the existing meta-weights w1 but restrict to the small, stable pool1 to see if a focused weighted mean improves over best single ETS.
Test a robust median combo on the small stable pool1 to see if simple median beats weighted or best single.
Test a trimmed mean over the full 19‑model pool to see if a robust average outperforms best single ETS.
Test a weighted combination using inverse‑error weights on the stable pool5 to see if a data‑driven weighting beats the best single ETS.
Test a weighted average on pool3 with the gradient‑boosted weights (w2) to see if a different subset improves over the current leader.
Try a dba strategy on the small pool1 to see if iterative refinement beats the current best single ETS.
Test a robust median combination on the moderately stable pool2 to see if it beats the current best ETS single.
Test a weighted combination using pool2 with inverse_error weights to see if a simple inverse‑error weighting improves over the current best single ETS.
Test a median combination over pool3 to see if a robust central tendency beats weighted or mean strategies.
Test a DBA combination on pool2 to see if iterative weighting can improve over the current leader.
Test a weighted combination on pool3 using inverse error weights to see if a more targeted weighting beats best_single ETS.

decision.justification: Selected 'best_single ETS' (an agent proposal) as the best of 22 backtested attempts, score 0.5465. Series context: trend strength 0.7635 and seasonal strength 0.3287; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau 0.119); 3 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 0.375.
